title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode19 The Hope I Saw That Day

meta.Episode: Episode19 — The Hope I Saw That Day

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry to keep asking you up here like this, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, it's all right. What did you need to talk to me about today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Actually, we wanted to ask you to come somewhere with us! We thought that a change of scenery might help cheer you up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All right. Sorry for making you worry so much. I can't stay out late, though, so I can't go too far.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't worry! It's not far, so we'll be there in no time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Minori, why are you grabbing my hand?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All right, Haruka! Time to go visit our SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That light! Are you trying to—
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I thought so. But why bring me back here, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori? Where'd she go?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Momoi! Hinomori! Miku! Rin!
Let's do it just like we practiced!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: We've got this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? What are Minori and the others doing on stage?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello! My name is Minori Hanasato!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is a little sudden, but there's an idol I look up to more than anyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's you, Haruka Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka has given me more hope than I can put into words!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But right now, she's having a really hard time and she always looks so sad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to help restore her faith in tomorrow, even if only a little. That is the reason I'm up here today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that's why we're going to give it everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We hope you enjoy the show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's gonna be the best show you've ever seen!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So please listen as we sing with all our heart!
song00002_minori_s

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(She's off to a perfect start!
Her voice is reaching farther than ever before!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She seems a little nervous, but she's moving just like we practiced. Keep it up, Minori. All that's left is to reach Haruka.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Blue...glow sticks?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Big movements. Make sure to move all the way to my fingertips. Control my breathing and don't lose the pace!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I've got to use all the strength I have to reach her!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I've got to make sure Haruka can see this view again!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Minori's shoulders look a little tense, but she's really giving it everything she's got.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm sure she's trying to make her feelings reach me.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What do I do? This is my first solo since I debuted. I'm so nervous. Everyone is looking forward to this so much. What if I mess up?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(No, an idol is meant to give hope.
I can't let myself think such negative thoughts. I can do this!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Everyone, thank you for coming today!
I'm going to give it every...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Oh, no... My voice is shaking.
What am I going to do? I have to sing all by myself...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Everyone's glow sticks are turning blue...
It's so pretty...

rows.Speaker: Fan A
rows.Line: Good luck with your solo, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Fan B
rows.Line: You can do it! We believe in you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That's right.)
song00002_off_sabi

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I'm not the only one doing the giving.
The only reason I can be an idol is because of all the love everyone gives me.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I want to give even more back to them. I want to give them a show good enough to say thank you for this view they've given me!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for your support! I can feel your love filling the stage! Now it's my turn to give it all back to you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right. That view was created by everyone's feelings. I...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haruka, are you enjoying the show? Everyone practiced really hard, you know!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Look! There are blue lights as far as you can see!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Miku... Rin...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right. It's just like that view that I loved so much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I know it must look even more beautiful from up on stage, but...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... Th-Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, Haruka! Would you join us on stage?
The view from up here is beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We worked really hard because we wanted you to see this view! We thought seeing it from the stage once more might help you move forward again!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I can't...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My legs are shaking just from standing near the stage.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In that case, grab my hand!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, you've given me so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I started dancing because I wanted to be just like you. I was never very good at sports, but this was fun. Before I realized it, I'd fallen in love with dancing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I even made a lot of friends by going to see your shows. I don't see them very often because of how far away they live, but we still keep in touch.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And the first time you waved at me during one of your shows, I was so happy that I started crying.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It was the first time I realized having feelings for someone else could make you so happy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And... And...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, you gave me my dream of becoming an idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is about all I can do for you, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want you to see this view! To remember what's it's like to look forward! I want you to believe again that tomorrow will be a better day!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haruka, what do you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I want to get on stage!
I want to see that view once more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Go on and take Minori's hand! Everything will be fine! We'll help you get up on stage as well!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Up you go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I-I'm...actually on stage...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But...I'm still shaking so badly I can't stand.
Gasp...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If that's the case, we'll support you as many times as it takes. That's what we're here for. Now give me an arm. Airi will take the other one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There you go. If you can't do something alone, all you need is some help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: C'mon, Haruka. Stop staring down at your feet already. Turn around and look up!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is all the light of the hope you've given people.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The reason I strive to be an idol. Being able to perform here on stage with the others. It's all thanks to the hope you've given me, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If it hadn't been for you, I would never have experienced this view. All these lights represent the number of times you've given me hope.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So I want to tell you over and over again!
I'm really, truly grateful for all the hope you've given me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I gave you...hope...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. So it really did reach you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? My phone is glowing.
No, wait, it's the Untitled track?!
